correctness.rationale: The Hamiltonian is normalized as one penalty J per disjoint equal-color pair and field -h for each site of color 0. A fifteen-step ternary recursion and an independent 2^15 induced-edge dynamic program with ordered three-set partitions exhaust exactly 14,348,907 configurations. Both reproduce each of the sixteen exact sector minima and multiplicities; the latter also establishes equality of the full 180-element extremal set with the two-star-plus-K4 construction. Exact rational pairwise affine inequalities over every sector establish four and only four field thresholds and all coexistence degeneracies. The actual package code was compiled and replayed successfully; full finite enumeration, not sampling, proves the finite claim.

value.rationale: KG(6,2) is the first two-subset Kneser graph that cannot be properly three-coloured, so the exact minimal frustration is a natural quantitative refinement of the classic chromatic obstruction. The entire 180-element ground-state set is classified by a rigid two-star-plus-K4 structure, rather than just a numerical sample. The field diagram and coexistence degeneracies give complete exact finite-size magnetic benchmarks, with distinct magnetization sectors and entropy jumps. This finite result is structurally motivated; it does not require a new thermodynamic theorem to be valuable.
